name: G6 T3 W11 - Explain and improve saved work
description: Optional review. No required vocabulary task this week. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: Information or a signal given to a computer or program.
words.example: Pressing button A provides an input to the program.

words.definition: Information or a signal produced by a computer or program.
words.example: The displayed number is an output from the counter.

words.definition: A named place in a program that stores a value which can change.
words.example: The variable count stores the number of button presses.

words.definition: A check used to find out whether something works as expected.
words.example: We test the program by pressing the button three times.

words.definition: Information about work that can help someone improve it.
words.example: The feedback says to check the displayed total after a reset.
